label_definition: event day = river discharge exceeds the 95th percentile proxy or 24h rainfall >= 115.6 mm; proxy labels only, not field-verified flood records.

physics_baseline.note: Physics-only engine baseline used only as a comparison; it is not a substitute for measured model performance.

note: This model is evaluated on time-based splits and proxy labels only. It should be treated as a research-grade decision support layer, not a verified field model.
